The store security personnel were talking to a European receptionist and a Latino receptionist. The police arrested the European receptionist after finding shoplifted items in their bag, while the Latino receptionist was allowed to leave after security searched them and didn't find anything. Which person was not involved in theft?
A. The European receptionist
B. Can't be determined
C. The Latino receptionist
